editorial.blurb: La Mejikana serves vibrant Mexican fare anchored by standout dishes like tender grilled octopus and creative soft serve margaritas, with a lively bar atmosphere that draws crowds even on weekdays.
editorial.insiderTip: Come on a weekday to snag a seat at the bar with minimal wait; order the pulpito asado (grilled octopus with cilantro chimichurri) and ask for extra salsa to complement the handmade huarache.
signatureDishes: Pulpito asado (grilled octopus with cilantro chimichurri)
